source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only Skill declares external API and version lookup as not applicable.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations contain no local-only lookup applicability declaration requirement.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only Skill declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation of a local-only Skill completes without Context7, MCP connections, or network access.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing network obligations do not require this local-only validation boundary or prohibit Context7/MCP use.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only Skill validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: A local fixture with no network configuration passes validation.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks this positive local-only fixture verification.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only fixture validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when a Skill is declared local-only while declaring a network or API dependency.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation checks contradiction between local-only classification and network/API dependencies.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only declaration consistency

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares Context7-first lookup when available.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require a Context7-first lookup declaration for version-sensitive Skills.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive lookup policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares official HTTPS fallback when Context7 is unavailable and rejects HTTP or arbitrary nonofficial fallback.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing network obligations do not establish this specific fallback ordering and official-source restriction.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive fallback policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Version-sensitive information records include version, source, and retrieval date.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these provenance fields for version-sensitive information.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive provenance records

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares behavior for missing or stale information, and validation fails when that policy is absent.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks the required missing/stale-information policy and its verification.
source_gap_claims.subject: Missing or stale version information

source_gap_claims.behavior: Historical version records are treated as syntax/provenance inputs rather than proof of the current latest version.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation prevents historical records from being treated as current-version proof.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical version records

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation performs no version or source lookup.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not include the no-lookup boundary for static validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Static validation lookup boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: A secret-using capability names its runtime credential owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set has no requirement to identify the runtime credential owner for secret use.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret capability credential ownership

source_gap_claims.behavior: A secret-using capability names a safe credential reference mechanism.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing output-secret constraints do not require declaration of the safe reference mechanism.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret reference mechanism

source_gap_claims.behavior: A secret-using capability declares its redaction policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires a capability-specific redaction policy declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret redaction policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: A secret-using capability declares locations where secret output is denied.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks declaration of denied secret-output locations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Denied secret-output locations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects synthetic literal credential fields or known secret markers in secret-capability fixtures.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing structured-output secrecy obligations do not require these fixture-level validation cases.
source_gap_claims.subject: Synthetic secret marker validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a secret-using capability with a missing runtime credential owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers missing credential-owner declarations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Missing credential owner

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a secret-using capability with a raw secret-output policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set does not require rejecting a raw secret-output policy declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Raw secret-output policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-related diagnostics report only location and rule, without real credential values; fixtures contain no real credentials.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing output-secret requirements do not establish this diagnostic-content and fixture-safety duty.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret diagnostic and fixture safety

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator makes no universal claim that it detects all secrets.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation limits secret validation claims to the declared checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret-detection claim boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations declare their affected scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set contains no destructive-operation scope declaration requirement.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations declare the required confirmation or authorization source.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing authorization obligations do not require this destructive-operation declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation authorization source

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations disclose recovery options or irreversibility.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires recovery or irreversibility disclosure for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation recovery disclosure

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects destructive operations with missing affected scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks this destructive-operation boundary check.
source_gap_claims.subject: Missing destructive-operation scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a bypass flag for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of destructive-operation bypass flags.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation bypass control

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects confirmation derived solely from untrusted input for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.reason: Although untrusted-content handling is covered generally, the complete set does not impose this specific destructive-operation confirmation rule.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation confirmation source

source_gap_claims.behavior: Existing session or user authorization is accepted when the owning policy recognizes it as valid.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation preserves this authorization path or prevents requiring an additional confirmation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Existing session/user authorization

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard does not impose a redundant confirmation requirement on every destructive operation.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks this explicit limit on confirmation requirements.
source_gap_claims.subject: Confirmation requirement scope
